title: Activate Math Discovery protocol Verification with independent public-export consumer proof
commitMessage: test: verify portable Discovery public export from isolated consumer

contribution.summary: Start Math Discovery protocol Verification and prove an attested public export is structurally valid and tamper-refusing when copied to an isolated consumer.
contribution.value: Activate only the ready M8-W01-C01-T1-V subtask through target-reentrant DWF continuation. Add a Math-owned .NET 11 test that uses the actual public --export CLI, copies all fourteen exported files into an isolated consumer, checks thirteen receipt SHA-256 identities and four selected CLR metadata identities against the pinned 13-case protocol boundary, runs the existing strict gate on the copied manifest, and executes its standalone verifier from a separate working directory. Require fresh member and authorization mutations to be refused and restore the clean export. No completion or broker adoption claimed.
debtChanges: RS290 succeeded first-pass and completed GREEN with one evidence-backed achievement, admitting the Verification leaf to ready while the accepted parent task stayed in-progress.
Prior positive exports and in-wrapper refusal tests did not independently exercise the public --export mode followed by a copied portable consumer and a separately launched offline verifier.

The new verification is checksum/metadata-only; private published binaries, source-qualified protocol pins, historical receipts, unsigned-origin limitations and external broker responsibility are preserved.
contribution.nextAction: If independent RS291 Verification succeeds, separately assess one evidence-backed Verification completion and truthful parent-task progress before moving to the selected CLR-binding task.
